summary: Roblox chat read from the start, and two fixes on the website

groups.title: Chat safety
items: Roblox chat that is already on screen when a game opens is now read. Chat safety no longer waits for a new message before it checks what is there.

groups.title: Website and web app
items: A double press on an example on the guest scan page no longer uses two of your guest scans.
Sharing twice quickly from your phone no longer loses the second share. The second one is checked.
